notes.title: Official version of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage to release with V-tuber NGRuli!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846858/47d71cb3cdb40cc7af779c09d678397cd3a17090.jpg

Hello from the team at CFK.

There's only two days left until the official release of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage!

On April 17th (Wednesday), starting from 7:30 PM Korea Standard Time, RULIWEB V-tuber NGRuli will unveil the official version of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage during her broadcast.

Be sure not to miss out on the early playthrough and the behind-the-scenes glimpses from developer Deerfarm!
*Please note that the broadcast will be held only in Korean.

◎ Broadcast information

Date/Time - May 17th, 2024 (Wednesday) 7:30 PM KST

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712480/Shikhondo_Youkai_Rampage/

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

◎ Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage Official Launch Trailer

[previewyoutube=D9KyHbx784M;full][/previewyoutube]
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

◎ Information on the special player appreciation discount for owners of Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater

As a special thank you to the players who purchased Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater, we're planning to offer an additional 40% discount on Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage. If you purchase during the first two weeks after release, add that to the 10% discount to get a whopping 50% discount on this new game!

In addition, if holders of the original title purchase the digital deluxe version of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage, they'll get up to a 55% discount.

Player appreciation discount period: April 18th, 2024 (Thurs.) – October 14,2024 (Mon.)
* Discount will be applied automatically for players with Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater in their libraries.

We hope to drum up lots of interest, and thank you!

Best wishes,
CFK

notes.title: Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage release date announced!
notes.content:
Hello from the team at DeerFarm.

Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage, the vertically scrolling shoot'em up about the journey of a girl fallen into a new world and the Grim Reaper who meets her there, will be officially released to Steam on April 18, 2024 (Thursday).

◎ Price
$14.99 (10% off until 5/2 → $13.49)

◎ Information on the special player appreciation discount for owners of Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater
As a special thank you to the players who purchased Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater, we're planning to offer an additional 40% discount on Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage. If you purchase during the first two weeks after release, add that to the 10% discount to get a whopping 50% discount on this new game!

In addition, if holders of the original title purchase the digital deluxe version of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage, they'll get up to a 55% discount.

Player appreciation discount period: April 18th, 2024 (Thurs.) – October 14,2024 (Mon.)
* Discount will be applied automatically for players with Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater in their libraries.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712480/Shikhondo_Youkai_Rampage/

◎ Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage official trailer
[previewyoutube=D9KyHbx784M;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you'll continue your outpouring of love and interest for the upcoming Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage.

Many thanks,
The team at DeerFarm

notes.title: Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater to be unlisted
notes.content:
Hello!

Let us start by thanking all of the gamers who have played and recalled Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater for these past 7 years.

On April 18th, 2024 (Thursday), we will be releasing Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage, a new version of this game we've been working on alongside publisher CFK.

Players with Shikhondo(食魂徒) - Soul Eater in their libraries will still be able to play the game, and as a special thanks to those of you who look back on the original, those players will also be able to receive a special discount on Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage.

◎ New features of Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage
- Character voices added
- New stage added
- Resolution / UI / Effect remaster
- New Dual mode added / Customize mode reworked

For more detailed information, visit:

◎ Shikhondo: Youkai Rampage Steam store page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712480/Shikhondo_Youkai_Rampage/

Alongside this release, we are still hard at work on the sequel to this game, Shikohondo: Blue Pieta.
We hope you'll continue to closely follow the Shikhondo series.

Many thanks,
The team at Deerfarm
